name: golo-golf-website
//engines: 20.9 is the floor sharp 0.35.5 sets (the release that fixes the libvips/libheif/librsvg advisories). next uses sharp for next/image in production. The VPS and CI run Node 20 (.nvmrc).
//browserslist: Modern-only targets, matched to the browsers that support AVIF and CSS image-set (what the backdrops in globals.css rely on). Governs SWC transpilation of app code and autoprefixer. NOTE: this does NOT clear Lighthouse's 'Legacy JavaScript' audit — those polyfills come from next/dist/build/polyfills/polyfill-module.js, which Next injects into the client bundle unconditionally.
//overrides: next 15.5.x pins postcss to exactly 8.4.31, which is inside GHSA-qx2v-qp2m-jg93, GHSA-6g55-p6wh-862q, GHSA-fxqj-rqcc-2cmp and GHSA-r28c-9q8g-f849 (fixed in 8.5.23). 8.5 is API-compatible with 8.4. Remove this once next widens its postcss range.
